description: The file defines the 'VisitSearchCriteria' class used for encapsulating various filtering parameters when searching for visit records in the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for visit types, patients, locations, indications, date ranges, attributes, and flags for including inactive or voided visits. The class provides getters, setters, and a constructor for initializing these criteria.

classes.name: VisitSearchCriteria
classes.description: A data container class used to specify various optional filters for searching visit records in the system, such as visit types, patient info, location, indication, date ranges, and flags for including inactive or voided records.
